lines.text: After Solomon finished the house of the LORD and his palace, the LORD appeared to him at night.
The LORD said He would hear from heaven if His people humbled themselves, prayed, sought Him, and turned from wickedness.
The LORD said He might close the sky, send locusts to devour the land, or send a famine.
If Solomon walked before Him as his father Saul walked, the LORD would establish his royal throne.
If Israel served other gods, the LORD would uproot them and make the temple an object of scorn.
